description: Speech-to-text for YouTube audio. Use it when a video has no captions — or when you want a transcript of what was actually spoken rather than YouTube's published captions. Priced per started minute of audio. Costs 2 credits/min of audio. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

language.description: Preferred caption language as an ISO code, e.g. "en". Defaults to auto-detect.

maxCredits.description: Refuse before STT when estimatedCredits would exceed this (400 cost_exceeds_max, 0 credits).

url.description: Public YouTube video URL, e.g. https://youtube.com/watch?v=ID. Not a TikTok/Instagram/Facebook URL. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: youtube_audio_transcript
title: YouTube Audio Transcript
